verdict.rationale: Pipecat Flows provides multi-step conversation paths with node transitions, but the evidence shows they are defined in Python code: functions and metadata are derived from function signatures and docstrings. Nothing in the pack documents a visual or no-code builder. Whisker gives a live graph of a running pipeline, but it is a debugger, not a flow-design tool, so it is only adjacent.

support.subject: As a founder, I can design multi-step conversation flows in a visual builder with branching, states, and handoffs without writing code
